title: Completing the quantifier lookup
statement: Let $x$ be a finite bit string, let $B,k,S$ be natural numbers, and let $v$ be a Boolean. If $2k\le B$ and $S\le B$, then the seven-register program has a run, with its specified oracle, from the first copy phase of the return procedure carrying $v$ and register values $(k,S,0,0,0,0,0)$ to the quantifier-reading state carrying $v$ and register values $(k,S,2k,0,0,0,0)$. Every configuration strictly before the endpoint satisfies the program precondition and has all register values at most $B$.
replaced:
Let $x$ be a bit string and let $B,k,S$ be natural numbers. For either Boolean value
$v$, if $2k\le B$ and $S\le B$, the fixed seven-register program, with its specified
oracle, can run from the first copy phase of the return procedure carrying $v$, at depth
$k$ and stack value $S$, to the quantifier-reading state carrying $v$, with the same
depth and stack value and with input pointer $2k$. The scratch registers are zero at
both endpoints; throughout the run, every register remains at most $B$ and every
configuration satisfies the program's precondition.
